::: {.panel-tabset}

#### p=mean

```{r echo=FALSE,include=TRUE}
p_TARGET <- "mean"
Hs <- SHT[ID==ID_TARGET]$Hs |> unique() 
Name <- SHT[ID==ID_TARGET]$Name |> unique()
Da_TARGET <- Hs*100*XDa
Vs30_TARGET <- SHT[ID==ID_TARGET]$Vs30 |> unique() 
Ts_TARGET <- SHT[ID==ID_TARGET & level==p_TARGET]$Ts |> unique() 
Caption <- CAP |> sprintf(Name,TR_TARGET,Vs30_TARGET,Ts_TARGET,min(Da_TARGET),100*min(XDa),max(Da_TARGET),100*max(XDa),p_TARGET)
TBL <- KIT[ ID==ID_TARGET & TR==TR_TARGET & Vs30==Vs30_TARGET & p==p_TARGET]
TBL |> buildTable(library="gt",font.size.body = FONT.SIZE.BODY,font.size.header = FONT.SIZE.HEADER,font.bold.header=TRUE, caption=Caption)

```
